description: first_over_time and last_over_time with unwrap under an aggregation, the shape Grafana Explore sends with $__auto (semantics/unwrap-first-last-range-timestamps): F1 and F2 take a range equal to the step and must answer Loki's evaluation timestamps from relabelled step buckets, F3 is a range longer than the step over a series per line (semantics/unwrap-first-last-per-line-range-longer-than-step, open), F4 the same over a series a keep decides (semantics/unwrap-first-last-range-longer-than-step). Run with the control set.
